intersections.note: Evans printed only 'ST.' below W. 8th, 'EVANS' further south on the same street; short north stub to the plate edge. W. 8th's north face is cut by the plate edge (y~158 west of Evans, ~178 east); south face y~275 west, ~265 east (under the viaduct). y taken mid-band / on the printed 'STREET' label, less certain (~15 px)
Perin starts at the foot of the Evans diagonal; Evans turns due south here (bend coincides with the T)
W. 6th (printed 'W. SIXTH ... ST.') runs E-W east of Evans and as a WSW diagonal west of Evans (bend at the crossing); the diagonal carries the 12-inch sewer and 16-inch water pipe

widths.note: '90'' printed vertically in W. 8th just west of Evans; read as the street width (its north face is beyond the plate edge)

bends.note: due-south section from W. 8th turns SSE (diagonal to Perin)
E-W section turns SE, crossing the C. C. C. & St. L. and B. & O. tracks; no name printed on this segment, continuous with the W. Sixth street lines
SE section turns ENE onto the bridge over Mill Creek (16-inch water pipe printed along it)
ENE section east of Mill Creek turns ESE toward the plate edge

ends.note: south end at the railroad tracks (only a sewer line and a stub track continue south)
east dead end at the Mill Creek bank
west dead end against buildings on lots 24 and the one-storey building at x~8005-8040; does not reach Evans
east dead end at the purple boundary band / lot 33; railroad along its south side
plate edge (east), on the viaduct over Mill Creek
plate edge (east), past the Mill Creek bridge

notes: Strip f: x 7620-10516 plus overlap from x 7320; full height, but the plate ends at y~3600 (Ohio River) and everything south of the tracks (y>2000) is railroad, the roundhouse, J. W. Price's Heirs subdivision lots, Mill Creek and the river, with no streets. W. 8th Street (printed 'W. EIGHTH STREET' west of Evans) continues east of Evans under the 'VIADUCT' label with addresses 1573-1559 printed in it; recorded as West 8th Street. W. 6th west of Evans continues WSW past the strip's west edge (label '...ET' at x~7050, y~1950), straight within the strip (centre about y=1724+0.25(7882-x)). Evans also has '50'' printed in it just north of the tracks (x~7893, y~1905); width entry uses the '60'' on the north stub. Not streets: the 9 ft strip between a dashed line (x~8338) and the green band (x~8360) from the viaduct to Perin, and the purple band at x~8340 south of W. 6th (boundary bands); the diagonal lot strip (lots 64, 3) north of Perin at x~8580-9010; the C. C. C. & St. L. and B. & O. railroads; Mill Creek; the B. & O. (?) railroad bridge at y~2150. Channel Street (printed 'CHANNEL ST.') touches no other street on this plate.
